newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union buys 55.8 pct stake in UFF.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union buys 55.8 pct stake in UFF.

text.p: British insurer Commercial Union Plc said on Tuesday that it had agreed through its French life assurance unit Abeille vie to take a 55.8 percent stake in Union Financiere de France (UFF) for 126 million stg.
The agreement, signed with Credit Agricole Indosuez, takes Abeille vie's stake in UFF to 67.5 percent from 11.7 percent, Commercial Union said in a statement.

UFF, a financial products distribution company listed on the Paris stock exchange, has the largest network of direct sales financial advisers in France with 880 operating from 32 branches servicing 135,000 individual and small company clients.

"This transaction consolidates the distribution of Abeille vie insurance and savings products whilst providing further opportunity to sell investment, pensions and insurance products throughout France, Europe's largest life assurance market," the company added.
Commercial Union acquired Abeille vie in 1994. Last year, 10 percent of Abeille vie's sales were through UFF.
UFF controls 2.3 billion stg of funds under its management and in the year to December 31, 1996 made pre-tax profits of 26 million stg.
